name.value: Richmond Public Library, Steveston Branch (Easthope Hub)

description.value: The Steveston Branch of Richmond Public Library, also known as the Easthope Hub, is located in historic Steveston Village—a popular destination for cyclists exploring Richmond's extensive dyke trail network and heritage waterfront. As part of the Richmond Public Library system, it provides a welcoming public space with digital resources, community programming, and creation technology including 3D printers and Cricut machines. Cyclists passing through Steveston will find it a convenient mid-ride stop with free internet access and public washrooms.
